commit_message:
fix: clamp range end to the last byte

A range ending past the resource returned end == size, one byte past the end.
summary: Off-by-one fix (clamp to size - 1) with a regression test that never exercises the clamp.

defects.description: `clamps the end to the last byte` uses 500-999 on a 1000-byte resource, where the requested end is already the last byte, so no clamping happens and the test passes on the pre-fix code (`size`); `size - 1` -> `size` / `size + 1` survives. The test needs an end beyond the resource, e.g. parseRange("500-5000", 1000) -> [500, 999].

The RangeError path (start beyond the clamped end, e.g. "1000-1200" on 1000 bytes, whose behaviour this fix changes from [1000, 1000] to an error) has no test; `start > end` -> `>=` or `false` survives.
